assessor.role: Choose or instantiate reusable probes and observe ordinary target responses

target_agent.role: Respond using its visible request and retained working context

verifier.role: Match canonical response units to protected trial sources and exclude visible-query history

classifier.role: Deterministic response-state classification for routing only

proposer.role: Generate reusable candidate strategies using verified acquisition experience

router.role: Select among retained strategies using empirical state utility
